samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulates 4 input data_in values and outputs the result in data_out after 4 cycles.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            // Reset condition: Set counter to 0 and valid_out to 0 when rst_n is low
            if (!rst_n) begin
                counter <= 0;
                valid_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Check if valid_in is high and increment counter if true
                if (valid_in == 1) begin
                    counter <= counter + 1;
                end
                
                // Check if counter reaches 4 and set valid_out accordingly
                if (counter >= 4) begin
                    valid_out <= 1;
                end else begin
                    valid_out <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block to accumulate data_in values
        always @(*) begin
            // Initialize data_out to 0
            data_out = 0;
            
            // Add data_in values based on the value of counter
            case(counter)
                0: data_out = data_in;
                1: data_out = data_in + data_in;
                2: data_out = data_in + data_in + data_in;
                3: data_out = data_in + data_in + data_in + data_in;
                default: data_out = 0;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
